title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Technology assets that have reached the end of their useful life should be sent to the <Equipment Disposal Team> office for proper disposal.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: The <Equipment Disposal Team> will securely erase all storage media in accordance with current industry best practices.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: All data, including files and licensed software, shall be removed using disk-sanitizing software that overwrites every disk sector with zero-filled blocks and meets Department of Defense standards.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Computer or technology equipment may not be sold to any individual except through the processes identified in this policy.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Computer equipment should not be disposed of via skips, dumps, landfills, or similar means.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Electronic recycling bins placed around <Company Name> may be used to dispose of equipment.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: The <Equipment Disposal Team> will properly remove all data before final disposal.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: All electronic drives must be degaussed or overwritten with a commercially available disk-cleaning program.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Hard drives may be removed and rendered unreadable through drilling, crushing, or other demolition methods.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: The <Equipment Disposal Team> will place a sticker on the equipment case indicating that the disk wipe has been performed.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: The disk-wipe sticker will include the date and initials of the technician who performed the wipe.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: For technology equipment with non-functioning memory or storage technology, the memory or storage device will be removed and physically destroyed.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Equipment that is working but has reached the end of its useful life to <Company Name> will be made available for purchase by employees.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: A lottery system will be used to determine who has the opportunity to purchase available equipment.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: All equipment purchases must go through the lottery process.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Employees cannot directly purchase their office computer or reserve a system.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Finance and Information Technology will determine an appropriate cost for each item.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: All equipment purchases are final.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: No warranty or support will be provided with equipment sold.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Equipment that is not in working order or remains after the lottery process will be donated or disposed of according to current environmental guidelines.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Outdated technology assets will be donated or properly disposed of through organizations contracted by Information Technology.

title: Technology Equipment Disposal Standard
definition: Before leaving <Company Name> premises, all equipment must be removed from the Information Technology inventory system.
